events.content:
Migration complete. Here's what was done:

**Created:**
- `app/layout.tsx` — Root layout replacing `_app.tsx` + `_document.tsx`, with `<html lang="en">`, shared metadata (description, viewport, favicon), and `<body>` wrapper
- `app/page.tsx` — Home page with `metadata` title export replacing `<Head>`, nav links using `<Link>` from `next/link`
- `app/about/page.tsx` — About page with `metadata` title/description exports, `<Link>` navigation

**Removed:**
- `pages/` directory (including `index.tsx`, `about.tsx`, `_app.tsx`, `_document.tsx`)

**Key changes:**
- `<Head>` from `next/head` → `export const metadata` (App Router convention)
- `next/document` → root `layout.tsx` with `<html lang="en">` and `<body>`
- `<a href>` → `<Link href>` from `next/link` for client-side navigation
- `_app.tsx`/`_document.tsx` merged into `layout.tsx`

Build passes successfully with all routes static.
